dynamical-spacetime.title: Einstein Field Equations with Cosmological Constant
dynamical-spacetime.description: Governs the gravitational dynamics of spacetime curvature in response to the distribution of mass-energy and momentum, establishing spacetime as a dynamical participant rather than a static background.

holographic-link.title: Ryu-Takayanagi Entanglement Entropy Formula
holographic-link.description: Relates the quantum entanglement entropy of a boundary subregion to the area of a minimal bulk surface in a holographic duality, bridging quantum information and spacetime geometry.

variational-foundation.title: Hamilton's Principle of Stationary Action
variational-foundation.description: Establishes that the physical trajectories of fields or particles are those that render the action functional stationary under all variations vanishing at the boundaries.

nuclear-cross-sections.title: Differential Nuclear Cross-Section
nuclear-cross-sections.description: Defines the differential nuclear cross-section as the ratio of the number of scattered particles per unit solid angle per unit time to the incident particle flux, governing the probability of specific scattering or reaction events.

quantum-tunneling-nuclear.title: Gamow Tunneling Probability and Coulomb Barrier Penetration
quantum-tunneling-nuclear.description: Formulates the quantum mechanical tunneling probability through the electrostatic Coulomb barrier for two interacting nuclei, governed by the Gamow parameter \eta.

pp-chain.title: Proton-Proton Chain Fusion Energy Generation Rate
pp-chain.description: Expresses the specific energy generation rate of the proton-proton chain fusion reactions as a non-linear function of stellar density, hydrogen mass fraction, and temperature.
